model.name: Traub et al. 2005 channel test cell with almost all channels in one compartment (TestSeg_all)
model.citation: Traub RD, Contreras D, Cunningham MO, Murray H, LeBeau FEN, Roopun A, Bibbig A, Wilent WB, Higley MJ, Whittington MA (2005). Single-Column Thalamocortical Network Model Exhibiting Gamma Oscillations, Sleep Spindles, and Epileptogenic Bursts. Journal of Neurophysiology 93(4):2194-2232. doi:10.1152/jn.00983.2004
model.license: GPL-2.0 (LICENSE preamble: applies to everything except directories Neuron, Fortran_ifc and Fortran_g77, which carry a cite-on-use condition)
model.expected_behavior: Single segment (d 20 um), "with almost all of the ChannelML mechanisms": the TestSeg_test2 channels plus ar (anomalous rectifier, Ih-like) 0.25, cal 0.5, cat 0.05, cat_a 0.05, kahp/kahp_deeppyr/kahp_slower 0.033 each, kc/kc_fast 2.0 mS/cm2 and a cad Ca pool. Harness: +0.08 nA 20-80 ms. Shipped reference for the jNeuroML OMV test (neuroConstruct/generatedNeuroML2/.test.mep, times in s): 4 spikes at 22.9, 46.3, 53.8 and 77.5 ms (intervals 23.5, 7.5, 23.7 ms). A copy at NeuroML2/cells/TestSeg_all.cell.nml has another harness, NeuroML2/test/LEMS_ChannelTest.xml (dt 0.01 ms; jNeuroML_NEURON test only). Not simulated in this sweep.
model.inclusion_reason: Richest channel mix in the sweep (Ih-like ar, T- and L-type Ca, AHP and C-type K) in one compartment, with a jNeuroML OMV reference. Caveats as traub2005_testseg2: artificial test cell, GPL-2.0, same family (never split the two). The very small dt (0.0005 ms) makes the canonical run slow.
